subject: Finalize Q1 Commit Traffic Plan & Closeflow
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Hall <sarah.hall@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Finalize Q1 Commit Traffic Plan & Closeflow

Team —

We have one full business day plus the weekend to lock the Q1 commits that roll into revenue for March. This thread is the single source for commit updates and blockers. Please update the attached q1_commit_rollup.csv by 9:30 PT tomorrow (3/30) with final commit state and PO/DocuSign status. High-level guidance below: 

What I need from each of you by 9:30 PT on 3/30:
- A single-line commit decision for every deal you own (Commit / No Commit / Commit w/conditions).
- If Commit: include expected start date and revenue recognition bucket (Mar vs Apr).
- If No Commit or Conditional: short reason and next required action owner + ETA.

Priority accounts to push (sorted by impact):
1) Acme Corp — legal is in late redlines (Sarah on CC). Need PO confirmation or DocuSign link.
2) Horizon Health — final technical review and privacy appendix.
3) NebulaPay — finance wants net-30 confirmation.

Operational items:
- Daily close bridge: 10:00 PT on 3/30 (join link in calendar invite).
- I'll run a 48h commit rollup at 11:30 PT on 3/31 for finance. If you can't make the bridge, post updates in the Google sheet and Slack #closeflow.
- Use the comments column in the rollup for any redlines/conditions (don’t send separate spreadsheets).

Attachments: q1_commit_rollup.csv (master).

Thanks — let’s keep updates concise.

Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Hall <sarah.hall@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalize Q1 Commit Traffic Plan & Closeflow

On Mon, 29 Mar 2027 at 08:14, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> We have one full business day plus the weekend to lock the Q1 commits that roll into revenue for March. ...

Quick rollup from my side (I edited the master sheet directly):
- Acme Corp (DEAL-ACME-2027Q1-17): Conditional Commit. Legal returned with two line-item redlines on data retention and liability caps. I have a proposed language in the attached HorizonHealth_term_redlines.pdf (track-changes). Sarah — can procurement accept the alternate liability cap? If not, request PO by EOD 3/30 and we can classify as "Commit w/conditions" for recognition in April.
- Horizon Health (DEAL-HH-09): Commit. Technical appendix signed; legal attach pending but not blocking revenue recognition for March.
- NebulaPay (DEAL-NP-03): No Commit. Finance needs explicit net-30 acceptance. Ben is taking point to confirm.

Notes:
- I set status flags in the spreadsheet: green (ready), amber (conditional), red (needs action).
- Attached the term redlines for Acme to show the exact language so legal can triage quickly.

Next steps: Jonas — I'll be on the 10:00 PT bridge. Ben — confirm NebulaPay status by 10:45 PT.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: HorizonHealth_term_redlines.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700

Locking NebulaPay as Commit w/condition: finance to accept net-30 in writing by 3/31 noon PT, otherwise fall into April recognition. I updated the sheet (NebulaPay row) and pasted finance confirmation thread link in the comments column.

Ben Carter
Account Exec, Payments
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Hall <sarah.hall@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalize Q1 Commit Traffic Plan & Closeflow

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and for surfacing the redlines. Procurement reviewed the proposed alternate liability cap and can accept the adjusted language with one minor edit to the notice period (we need 45 days instead of 30). I've attached the procurement note and will route the DocuSign packet by EOB today. If DocuSign completes before your 11:30 rollup, consider Acme a green commit for March.

DocuSign tracker: https://app.docusign.com/packets/ACME-3127 (procurement)

Sarah Hall

Acme Corp
